text:
maria (eng-platform): Heads-up — last 3 deploys we've seen intermittent OTLP exporter failures from pods in us-west-2: HTTP2 resets, gRPC streams getting EOFs. Errors spike for ~15-30s then recover. Not seeing backend OOMs.
kevin (eng-telemetry): Yep saw the alerts. Looks like a middlebox/ewma load balancer is dropping long-lived HTTP/2 streams. grpc transport gets the worst of it.
jessica (eng-sre): ops-bot fired this morning: exporter-error-rate > 5% for service=ingest-worker :scream:. Page briefly.
ops-bot: alert: exporter-error-rate > 5% (service=ingest-worker, region=us-west-2)
maria (eng-platform): Proposal: add an HTTP/protobuf fallback and an adaptive probe that switches protocol per-pod when persistent gRPC resets are detected. Keep gRPC as default for perf but automatically fallback to http for short periods.
sam (eng-platform): +1 to fallback. We should be careful around ordering: avoid flipping back-and-forth too quickly. Need cooldown and a per-pod circuit breaker.
kevin (eng-telemetry): I sketched a config model. Key ideas: per-exporter dynamic protocol preference, probe that attempts a short `curl` or small POST to /v1/traces, per-pod retry budget (tokens per minute), and an exponential backoff with jitter. Example YAML:```yamlexporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: https://otel-collector.prod:4318
    prefer_protocol: grpc # or http
    fallback_to_http: true
    probe_interval_ms: 15000
    probe_timeout_ms: 2000
    retry_policy:
      max_attempts: 5
      initial_backoff_ms: 200
      max_backoff_ms: 5000
      multiplier: 2.0
      jitter: 0.25
    tenant_retry_budget_per_minute: 1000
    circuit_breaker:
      failure_threshold: 0.1 # percent of requests failed in window
      window_seconds: 60
      cooldown_seconds: 30
```
kevin (eng-telemetry): Policy notes: `prefer_protocol` determines the optimistic path. `probe` only used to validate a protocol after a reset. Budget prevents noisy tenants from burning all retries.
maria (eng-platform): Nice. For the probe: do not send real spans during probe to avoid duplication. Probe should be a health ping (zero-length or special header `x-otel-probe: 1`).
jessica (eng-sre): What about observability? We need new metrics: `exporter.protocol_active{pod,zone}`, `exporter.probe_latency_ms`, `exporter.fallback_count`, `exporter.retry_budget_consumed`, and an SLO for span export success (p95 success rate).
kevin (eng-telemetry): Agreed. Also emit structured logs when a pod flips to http fallback: {event: "protocol_fallback", pod: "...", reason: "grpc_eof", recent_errors: 12}. That will help console rollouts.
sam (eng-platform): UI ask: make a small console card per-service: current protocol mix (grpc vs http), fallback rate, avg export latency, retry tokens left. That will help SEs debug without paging SRE.
maria (eng-platform): Tests: we should add unit + integration tests that simulate HTTP2 resets and validate fallback only triggers once threshold hit. Locally you can repro with `grpcurl -plaintext -rpc-header 'x-otel-probe:1' <host>:4317 ListTraces` and `curl -v -X POST https://.../v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @small.bin`
kevin (eng-telemetry): Also include a diagnostic endpoint on the exporter side `/internal/exporter/debug` that returns current protocol, last_probe, budget_remaining. Only enabled behind an admin flag.
jessica (eng-sre): For incident playbook: if fallback rate > 30% across machines -> failover to tiered collector region or trigger autoscale and ramp up short-lived HTTP proxies. Avoid global tenant throttles during incidents.
maria (eng-platform): One more: prefer server-side guidance header `x-otel-backoff-ms` in responses. If collector sends it, clients should respect it and adjust backoff. We'll add logic to parse that header from both gRPC metadata and HTTP responses.
sam (eng-platform): Implementation plan: (1) telemetry team adds config knobs + probe logic, (2) platform wires into sidecar and runtime flags, (3) console team surfaces metrics. Target: canary on dev and prod canary namespaces in 2 weeks.
kevin (eng-telemetry): I'll draft the PR for the runtime export layer. Will include feature flag `telemetry.adaptive_protocol_v1` and default it off for a rollout.
jessica (eng-sre): Please add an alert: exporter-fallback-rate > 20% for 1m -> page on-call. Also create a dashboard panel for fallback hotspots.
maria (eng-platform): Thanks. Anyone object to HTTP/protobuf as the fallback (not json)? JSON is easier but bigger. protobuf keeps payload parity.
sam (eng-platform): protobuf. Less overhead on parsing in collector.
kevin (eng-telemetry): I'll include a small compatibility shim for older collectors.
maria (eng-platform): OK I'll update the rollout RFC and add a short section about tenant budgets + cost accounting. Will drop the RFC link here when done. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploybot: canary rollout started for telemetry.adaptive_protocol_v1 in namespace=canary (maria)
maria (eng-platform): Great — follow-up: remember to add e2e that asserts no duplicate spans after switching protocols (idempotency header + dedupe on collector).
